newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Klipton buys security firms for 13 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Klipton buys security firms for 13 mln rand.

text.p: Klipton Ltd said on Friday it had bought the businesses and client bases of three armed response services for 13 million rand, to be paid in cash.

At the same time Klipton said it had sold its tool distributor business Sapco for six million rand with effect from January 1, 1997. The purchaser would also take on liabilities of about 1.8 million rand.
It said the businesses bought were Astron, Bexgroup and Bexforce Centurion, which operate out of the Gauteng area.
Klipton said the acquisition meant that certain facilities and services would be rationalised and restructured over the next six to nine months.
The purchases will have no effect on Klipton's earnings in the current year, and are expected to have a modest effect in the year commencing July 1997.
The Sapco sale will have a negligible effect on earnings in the current year. The cash from the sale will be used to fund the security businesses' acquisition.
